howto.name: Upload the stamped PDF
howto.text: Select a PDF that carries Bates numbering applied by PrivaTools or another tool.

howto.name: Describe the stamp
howto.text: Give the prefix, digit count and any suffix used when the numbers were applied, so the tool matches those stamps and leaves real page content alone.

howto.name: Download the clean PDF
howto.text: The matching stamps are removed and the rest of the page is untouched. The original on your device is never modified.

faq.q: Will this remove numbering added by another program?
faq.a: Usually, if the stamps were added as text and you can describe their shape: prefix, digit count, suffix. Numbers burned into a scanned image are part of the picture and cannot be lifted this way.

faq.q: Why do I have to type the prefix and digits?
faq.a: So the tool removes stamps and nothing else. A bare search for numerals would happily delete page numbers, figures and dates. Describing the format is what keeps the removal surgical.

faq.q: Does removing Bates numbers change the rest of the page?
faq.a: No. Only the matching stamp objects are removed; the remaining text, images and layout are untouched, and the file on your device is never modified.
